title: Robinhood is down 23% after Q3, Supervielle's average target implies124%, and Oxford Lane is down 38% after a miss
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Brokers, banks and fintech had a rough 30-day stretch in a few names,  
plus a large Supervielle target and a couple of upcoming prints.  
30-day moves are from today's write-ups, not live quotes.  
  
Here is the scorecard from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. Robinhood Markets (HOOD)\*\* — Shares fell about 23% over 30 days,  
from about $101.08 on October 14 to $77.86 on November 13, per the  
write-up, not a live quote. The pullback followed a late-October Q3  
report with slower revenue growth and lower EPS than a year earlier.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/robinhood-markets-hood-slides-23-over-30-days-after-q3-earnings-and-crypto-weakness-38452/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/robinhood-markets-hood-slides-23-over-30-days-after-q3-earnings-and-crypto-weakness-38452/)  
  
\*\*2. Grupo Supervielle (SUPV)\*\* — Supervielle is scheduled to report  
Q3, with consensus near $0.20 EPS on revenue of about $252.5 million.  
The bank returned to profitability in Q2, with attributable net income  
of AR$12.8 billion after an AR$18.2 billion Q1 loss.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/grupo-supervielle-supv-what-to-expect-as-q3-2026-earnings-approach-39359/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/grupo-supervielle-supv-what-to-expect-as-q3-2026-earnings-approach-39359/)  
  
\*\*3. Grupo Supervielle (SUPV)\*\* — The $12.30 central target is the  
average of five verified analyst targets, rounded from about $12.32.  
From about $5.48, reaching $12.30 would take a gain of about 124%.  
Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/grupo-supervielle-supv-analyst-targets-suggest-124-upside-from-recent-levels-39362/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/grupo-supervielle-supv-analyst-targets-suggest-124-upside-from-recent-levels-39362/)  
  
\*\*4. Oxford Lane Capital (OXLC)\*\* — Shares fell about 38% over 30  
days, from about $8.07 to near $5.00, and about 47% over three months,  
per the write-up, not a live quote. Today's write-up ties the slide to  
an earnings miss and a distribution cut.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/oxford-lane-capital-corp-oxlc-falls-38-in-30-days-after-earnings-miss-and-distribution-cut-39020/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/oxford-lane-capital-corp-oxlc-falls-38-in-30-days-after-earnings-miss-and-distribution-cut-39020/)  
  
\*\*5. BMO vs JPM\*\* — Earnings momentum versus scale and valuation, in  
one head-to-head. Who gets the AI's pick? Click to see.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/bmo-vs-jpm-weighing-earnings-momentum-against-scale-and-valuation-38548/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/bmo-vs-jpm-weighing-earnings-momentum-against-scale-and-valuation-38548/)  
  
\*\*6. Cypherpunk Technologies (CYPH)\*\* — The $4.90 target is a single  
published target from Cantor Fitzgerald (raised from $1.60 on  
September 10), not a multi-analyst consensus. From about $1.87,  
reaching $4.90 implies about 160% upside. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/cypherpunk-technologies-inc-cyph-and-the-path-to-160-upside-to-4-90-39369/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/cypherpunk-technologies-inc-cyph-and-the-path-to-160-upside-to-4-90-39369/)  
  
\*\*7. Telecom Argentina (TEO)\*\* — Consolidated revenue reached $1,778  
million, up 18% year over year, with service revenue up 19% to $1,714  
million. Adjusted EBITDA rose 37% to $642 million, lifting the margin  
to 36.1% from 31.3%.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/telecom-argentina-teo-delivers-strong-3q26-margin-expansion-and-cash-flow-growth-39330/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/telecom-argentina-teo-delivers-strong-3q26-margin-expansion-and-cash-flow-growth-39330/)  
  
\*\*8. Telecom Argentina (TEO)\*\* — The $17 central target is the average  
of five current analyst targets, rounded from about $16.84, with a  
wide range from $9.20 to $22.00. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/telecom-argentina-teo-can-shares-reach-the-17-analyst-target-39331/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/telecom-argentina-teo-can-shares-reach-the-17-analyst-target-39331/)  
  
\*\*9. XBP Global (XBP)\*\* — Q3 revenue was $182.8 million, down 12.6% as  
reported and 17.1% pro forma. The GAAP net loss was $89 million,  
including a $68.4 million non-cash goodwill impairment that the  
write-up says does not affect cash or operations.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/xbp-global-holdings-xbp-q3-2026-earnings-revenue-pressure-offset-by-margin-gains-and-bookings-strength-39416/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/xbp-global-holdings-xbp-q3-2026-earnings-revenue-pressure-offset-by-margin-gains-and-bookings-strength-39416/)  
  
\*\*10. PagSeguro Digital (PAGS)\*\* — The $10 central target is the  
average of nine verified targets (about $10.20, rounded). From about  
$7.98, that implies about 25% upside. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/pagseguro-digital-ltd-pags-can-it-reach-the-10-analyst-target-25-upside-potential-39338/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/pagseguro-digital-ltd-pags-can-it-reach-the-10-analyst-target-25-upside-potential-39338/)  
  
Is Robinhood's 30-day drop a Q3 hangover that is already priced in, or  
is Supervielle's +124% target the more interesting (and more  
speculative) setup?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 16) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
